title: Boolean fold and final symbol
statement: For every Boolean word $w$ and Boolean value $a$, folding the symbols of $w$ from left to right with the operation that replaces the accumulator by the current symbol, starting from $a$, yields the last symbol of $w$, or $a$ when $w$ is empty.
